# Designing for tvOS

People enjoy the big screen from across the room.

Some more preamble that is not the abstract.

**Display.** The TV is large.

## Best practices {#Best-practices}

Great tvOS experiences do the following.

- Help people concentrate on content by limiting onscreen controls. Secondary actions stay discoverable.
- Adapt to appearance changes like Dark Mode.
